program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define top-row (row g 0))
             (define color (find (lambda (v) (!= v 0)) top-row))
             (define L (count-if (lambda (v) (!= v 0)) top-row))
             (define lengths (append (range 1 (+ L 1)) (range (- L 1) 0 -1)))
             (define segments
               (map (lambda (k) (map (lambda (_) color) (range 0 k))) lengths))
             (define (join-segs segs)
               (if (null? segs)
                   (list)
                   (if (null? (cdr segs))
                       (first segs)
                       (append (first segs) (cons 0 (join-segs (cdr segs)))))))
             (define pyramid (join-segs segments))
             (define plen (length pyramid))
             (define oh (quotient (+ plen w (- 1)) w))
             (define total (* oh w))
             (define padded
               (append pyramid (map (lambda (_) 0) (range 0 (- total plen)))))
             (define (take lst k)
               (if (zero? k) (list) (cons (first lst) (take (cdr lst) (- k 1)))))
             (define (drop lst k) (if (zero? k) lst (drop (cdr lst) (- k 1))))
             (define (chunks lst k)
               (if (null? lst) (list) (cons (take lst k) (chunks (drop lst k) k))))
             (chunks padded w)))))
